# Aditya Deshmukh - Full-Stack Web and Mobile Developer

> Associate Software Engineer specializing in NestJS backend services, AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3), Next.js web applications, and React Native (Expo) mobile apps. Based in India, available for full-time remote software engineering roles worldwide.

## Professional Summary
Aditya Deshmukh is a Full-Stack Software Engineer with proven production experience shipping resilient backend APIs, managing cloud infrastructure, and releasing web and mobile applications from scratch to Google Play Store release. Educated with a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU).

## Core Technical Competencies
- Backend & Cloud: NestJS, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, AWS EC2, AWS RDS, AWS S3, REST APIs, Microservices, Razorpay Webhooks.
- Frontend & Mobile: Next.js, React.js, React Native (Expo), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, GSAP.
- DevOps & Tooling: Git, Docker, Vercel DNS, Google Play Console release management, MSG91 DLT OTP integration.

## Key Projects
- Quick Events Platform: Full-cycle exhibitor registration, live QR pass validation, and SMS OTP dispatches on AWS RDS PostgreSQL & EC2. (Live: https://adityapro.online)
- Content Genie: AI-powered subscription content generation platform with streaming responses and idempotent Razorpay webhook billing. (Live: https://contentgenie.adityapro.online, Repo: https://github.com/Aditya-Deshmukh9/ai-content-generator)
- Retail E-Commerce Storefront: High-performance fashion retail store with optimized Lighthouse scores and inventory synchronization. (Live: https://ecom-colab-a.vercel.app, Repo: https://github.com/Aditya-Deshmukh9/Ecommerce)
- NotifiQ Mobile Application: Cross-platform mobile habit and notification tracker built with React Native and offline-first local storage. (Live: https://notifiq-app.vercel.app, Repo: https://github.com/adi-de9)
- CONVOMAX Component Library: Refactored 200+ legacy administrative screens into reusable, WCAG-accessible React components for government and university portals. (Repo: https://github.com/adi-de9)
- Weather Forecast Web App: Predictive 5-day weather application with dynamic meteorological UI and geolocation. (Live: https://weather-forecast-internshala.netlify.app, Repo: https://github.com/Aditya-Deshmukh9/weather-forecast-webapp-javascript)
